source: Real GUI rendered offscreen from ProjectService.sample (synthetic; no Microsoft binaries, no Ghidra, no model).

shots.title: Paired code and analyst review
shots.alt: PatchTrace main window on the synthetic bounds-check sample. Left: a list of four function matches (added, removed and two modified). Centre: the older and newer decompiled read_item function side by side, with the inserted null and index check highlighted in the newer pane and a blank gap in the older pane. Right: a finding about a guard added before an indexed buffer access, its explanation, evidence list and analyst review controls.
shots.caption: The workspace: function matches, older and newer code side by side with the changed region highlighted, and the review panel.

shots.title: Ranked changes with change signals
shots.alt: The same window after Rank changes. The function list now begins with read_item scored 26 in square brackets, followed by report_invalid_index with a dash instead of a score, get_version scored 0 and debug_dump with a dash. The change signals list shows one bounds-check detector hit on newer lines 2 to 5, which are highlighted in the newer code pane.
shots.caption: Deterministic detectors order functions by research priority. The number is an ordinal attention score, not a vulnerability verdict, and a dash means the evidence needed was unavailable.

shots.title: Raw bytes view
shots.alt: The code panes switched to Hex (raw bytes): offset-addressed hexadecimal dumps of the older and newer files side by side, with whole-file scope, page and go-to-offset controls above them and a status line reporting that one line differs at equal offsets; that line is highlighted in both panes.
shots.caption: Raw Hex, Binary and Base64 views of the verified original bytes, with differing lines highlighted.

shots.title: Files panel
shots.alt: The PatchTrace workspace with the Files dock open below it. The dock compares recorded fields for the older and newer files (name, size, size change, SHA-256, hash comparison, format) with parsed PE fields for both files, including machine type AMD64, characteristics, entry point, image base, alignment and subsystem. The status line reports file inspection complete.
shots.caption: Files panel: recorded metadata and a bounded, read-only PE comparison alongside the workspace.

shots.title: Report export preview
shots.alt: The Export dialog. A format selector set to md, a destination field, a checkbox to include function code (off), one to include analyst notes (on), a note that absolute paths are redacted and raw provider responses are excluded, and an exact Markdown preview of the report beginning with the change ranking table.
shots.caption: Exports show the exact report first. Function code is opt-in, analyst notes are opt-out, and absolute paths are redacted.
